rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and matches the provided 3AA grade, with appropriate comments on ICM, TE, and thinning zona. Slight overstatement such as 'gold standard' and precise localization of structures may go beyond what can be confidently verified from a single image.
Strong integration of age-related aneuploidy risk, ovarian reserve, uterine factor, endometrial thickness, sperm parameters, and lifestyle factors with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and mostly well supported, especially around age versus morphology. Minor issues include assuming this is the only blastocyst and using somewhat simplified arithmetic for implantation probability.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading principles and common IVF practice, including attention to uterine evaluation and counseling on age-related aneuploidy. Slight overreach in strongly recommending PGT-A as routine and in some confidence around implantation estimates prevents a perfect score.

Provides clear next steps for transfer, lifestyle modification, luteal support, uterine cavity assessment, and future cycle planning. Recommendations are useful, though some could be more individualized to the specific uterine diagnosis and transfer protocol.
